subject: Re: Scope interlock and evidence plan for production tenancy
messages:
From: Leighton Harris <leighton@revoproducts.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: security@revoproducts.com
Date: 2027-08-14 09:12 -0700
Subject: Scope clarification and SOC2 evidence request for Revo POC

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Security is running a quick control mapping before we start the POC. We need the following information to close our intake: 

- A copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report (audit period and cover letter).
- Clarification on which infrastructure controls are covered by Redwood vs by your cloud provider (we'll need a short mapping table).
- A list of subprocessors (cloud providers, monitoring vendors, backups) and whether you can provide their SOC / ISO attestations or a bridge letter for the POC period (we're scoped for a June 1 - Nov 30, 2027 audit).
- Any evidence artifacts you can share for network segmentation, KMS custody, and log forwarding (high level; we'll ask for screenshots/downloads during SOC review).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an expected delivery date? Ideally we can have a first pass of docs by Aug 25.

Appreciate it — Leighton
Security Lead, Revo Products
leighton@revoproducts.com

---
Note: please include any redaction guidance if you send internal attachments.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Leighton Harris <leighton@revoproducts.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scope clarification and SOC2 evidence request for Revo POC

Leighton — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to support the POC and the SOC mapping. High-level answers and next steps below.

What we can provide (first tranche by Aug 24):
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (audit period) — attaching our 2026 Q4 report and a short cover memo that calls out the audit period and system boundary.
- Subprocessor list (current) with the roles we rely on (compute, storage, monitoring).
- A preliminary mapping table (controls ownership) that distinguishes: Redwood-managed controls (application auth, runtime access, data deletion APIs) vs provider-managed controls (hypervisor, physical data center, VPC host networking).
- Evidence matrix template (we'll send an XLSX) that annotates which artifacts we can supply immediately and which require additional coordination with our cloud provider (e.g., provider SOC, bridge letter).

What requires partner/provider documentation:
- KMS custody (for our hosted tier we use FoggCloud KMS; for private deployments customers can manage keys) — we'll need to include the FoggCloud SOC2 coverage or a bridge letter covering KMS custody for the POC audit window.
- Some low-level network controls (if you need provider topology attestations) — these come from FoggCloud or the underlying provider.

Proposed action items and owners: 
1) Naomi (me) — deliver Redwood SOC2 PDF + cover memo + subprocessor list + evidence_matrix_revoproducts.xlsx by Aug 24.
2) Marissa (Compliance) — coordinate request with FoggCloud for SOC attestation/bridge letter and confirm expected turnaround.
3) Karthik (Infra) — produce control ownership mapping and a short set of log-forwarding artifacts (IAM role list, example CloudTrail export config).
4) Ben (Sales Ops) — confirm any procurement/redaction constraints and HubSpot record.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and loop in FoggCloud security. If you need the bridge letter to explicitly reference your audit window (Jun 1 - Nov 30, 2027), call that out and we'll relay it to the provider.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026Q4.pdf, evidence_matrix_revoproducts.xlsx

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

— Sent from Redwood Console (brief)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Leighton Harris <leighton@revoproducts.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-16 14:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scope clarification and SOC2 evidence request for Revo POC — technical mapping

Naomi / Marissa / Leighton — quick technical breakdown to feed the mapping table. Keep in mind this is for the hosted POC configuration (default). We can adjust for a dedicated/private deployment if Revo requests.

Summary of control ownership (hosted):
- Redwood-managed:
  * Application-level auth (token issuance, user/session management) — we own and can provide access logs and token revocation records.
  * Model runtime controls (process isolation, container lifecycle) — can provide runtime config snapshots and container image SBOMs.
  * Data deletion APIs and retention config — evidence: retention policy screenshot and deletion audit logs (sample).

- Provider / FoggCloud-managed: 
  * Physical infrastructure, hypervisor and host OS patching — obtains coverage via FoggCloud SOC/ISO.
  * KMS custody (key material at rest) — FoggCloud KMS; we maintain encrypted objects and reference key ARNs but we do not hold root key material for hosted customers.
  * Underlying object storage durability & geo-redundancy — provider attestation.

Evidence artifacts we can attach immediately:
- Architecture diagram (redacted): logical VPC, public/private subnets, NAT/GW placement.
- IAM role list scoped to runtime and logging (example ARNs).
- Example CloudTrail/CloudAudit export config and a 7-day logs snapshot (redacted).
- KMS key usage logs sample (we can provide metadata but not raw key material).

What we'll ask FoggCloud for (Marissa to lead):
- Provider SOC2 summary and a bridge letter that explicitly covers KMS custody and host-level patching for Jun 1 - Nov 30, 2027 (or your preferred audit window).
- Any subprocessor attestations for their managed services (monitoring, backup).

Let me know if you need specific ARN-level lists or a full runbook for evidence extraction; I'll allocate time next week.

— Karthik
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
From: Leighton Harris <leighton@revoproducts.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: security@revoproducts.com
Date: 2027-08-19 16:07 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scope clarification and SOC2 evidence request for Revo POC — acknowledgement

Naomi / Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the rapid detail. The proposed deliverables and owners look good. Two quick items: 

1) Audit window: we'd like the bridge letter to align with Jun 1 - Nov 30, 2027. If FoggCloud can't cover that exact window, a statement mapping their most recent audit period to our window is acceptable (we'll document the gap).
2) Evidence acceptance: the evidence matrix should indicate which artifacts are sample vs full exports (so our auditors know what to request).

Please get the first set by Aug 24 and we will confirm the POC kickoff after review. If anything looks like it will slip, flag us by Aug 22.

Appreciate the coordination — Leighton
Security Lead, Revo Products
